text:
Cheerful hello arrivals crew,
Seating plans came up mid-afternoon, so just a quick note

Please keep the companion checks moving and flag any stall in the handoff path right away. The lounge side needs a clean pass from booking notes to arrival screening, and the records trail has to stay tight so nobody is guessing at who should be where. <<FACT F002>> If you see a mismatch in crate tags, carrier notes, or pickup names, send it up immediately and keep the tone calm with the traveler.

I need everyone to stay on top of the pet intake forms and the care log, since these pieces are being checked against the current passenger list before release to the gate team. Aisha Rossi and Sara Hassan may come up in the morning run, and Winnie is already in the file, so please keep those entries neat and easy to trace. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is counting on clean notes, plain handoffs, and no loose ends. If a passenger coordinator gives updated steps, capture them in the record right away and pass them along without delay.

Also, please remember that the lounge space is not the place for side chatter or rushed guesses. Keep the route clear, keep the entries exact, and lean on the records file before you confirm anything to the front desk. We need dependable companion travel, and the best way to protect it is steady attention from everyone on shift.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
